frequency_question: How often do announced federal debt management or intervention programs reach or exceed their targeted operational scale prior to any formal capping, suspension, or scaling back?
membership_rule: Includes major U.S. Treasury buyback, debt issuance, or liquidity intervention programs since 2000. Excludes one-off emergency rescue facilities managed exclusively by the Federal Reserve under Section 13(3) without Treasury debt management coordination.
